subject.title: feat: add runtime self context config and tool

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's v1 public runtimeContext config surface and model-facing runtime tool contract as a default-closed core feature?
rationale: The code can be repaired mechanically, but adding a top-level config contract plus a core runtime tool for scale/offload/cost awareness is a product/API direction choice that automation cannot own.

options.title: Approve v1 default-closed contract
options.body: Land the config-backed runtimeContext and runtime tool after the narrow bug fix and conflict refresh, keeping provider refresh/action execution/cost estimation out of scope.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Restrict or rename the public config/tool shape before merge if maintainers want less surface area in the first slice.

options.title: Pause for broader runtime design
options.body: Hold this PR until the companion placement-contract and provider/offload design are reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Approve v1 default-closed contract
recommendation.body: Land the config-backed runtimeContext and runtime tool after the narrow bug fix and conflict refresh, keeping provider refresh/action execution/cost estimation out of scope.
